describe-csv.name: Describe CSV
describe-csv.description: Load the named CSV and write a numeric summary plus a write-up. No invented columns or imputed values.

group-compare-bars.name: Group Compare Bars
group-compare-bars.description: Group a named measure by a named category, then write an aggregated CSV, PNG bars, and a write-up.

histogram-pack.name: Histogram Pack
histogram-pack.description: Histogram a named numeric column with a values CSV, PNG, and write-up. Bin width is an ask or a stated default.

missing-and-outliers.name: Missing and Outliers
missing-and-outliers.description: Missing-count CSV and outlier list for named columns using their fence. Do not impute or delete unless asked.

refresh-from-new-export.name: Refresh from New Export
refresh-from-new-export.description: Reload a new CSV with the same named columns, write a dated PNG, and compare file names, row counts, and date ranges.

scatter-and-corr.name: Scatter and Correlation
scatter-and-corr.description: Scatter two named numeric columns with a points CSV, descriptive correlation, PNG, and a write-up that is not a cause.

small-multiples.name: Small Multiples
small-multiples.description: Repeat the same chart for each value of a named facet column. One faceted PNG plus n per panel.

time-series-line.name: Time Series Line
time-series-line.description: Parse a named date column, apply their range and grain, write a series CSV and PNG line. No invented forecast.
